title: Why A4 almost keeps its shape when cut in half
description:
A4 has a hidden geometric rule. In the ideal A-series model, halving the long side and rotating the half preserves a 1:√2 ratio. An A3 design scales to A4 at about 70.7% of each length, while its area halves. Real paper dimensions are rounded to whole millimetres.
